notes: Implemented scraper using Guardian's per‑day archive pages (e.g., /world/2026/sep/30/all). Collected URLs from multiple sections (world, sport, culture, technology, business, politics, environment) to ensure ≥15 URLs per target day. Used polite_fetch for all HTTP requests, respected robots.txt, deduplicated URLs, wrote TSV to data/urls_custom/theguardian-com.tsv and printed per‑day counts. Fallback to sitemap approach was considered but archive pages provided full coverage across the window.
